result.description: SBDC testing pty Ltd   Employment Type:  Full-time (38 hours per week) role as a Contract Administrator  SBDC Testing is seeking an experienced Contract Administrator to support the commercial and administrative functions of our growing concrete testing operations. This role is responsible for managing contracts and variations, liaising with project stakeholders, overseeing contractor work, and ensuring compliance across our testing engagements with builders, suppliers and engineers.  As our project workload and client base continue to grow, we are seeking a dedicated Contract Administrator to manage the contractual and administrative side of our testing services. This is a full-time, office-based role supporting our operations across New South Wales, working closely with our technical and operations teams to ensure every engagement is properly documented, compliant, and delivered to the standard our clients expect.      Benefits   Competitive salary commensurate with experience  Ongoing professional development and training opportunities  Supportive and collaborative team environment  Career progression opportunities within a growing business  Standard full-time hours with a stable, permanent position    Task & responsibilities   Developing, reviewing and negotiating variations to contracts, programs, projects and services  Responding to inquiries and resolving problems concerning contracts, programs, projects, services provided, and persons affected  Managing paperwork associated with contracts, programs, projects and services provided  Working with project managers, builders, engineers and other stakeholders to ensure project goals are met  Advising senior management on matters requiring attention and assisting in implementing decisions  Overseeing work undertaken by contractors and reporting on variations to work orders  Preparing and reviewing submissions and reports concerning the organisation's activities  Collecting and analysing data associated with projects undertaken, and reporting on project outcomes    Qualification & experience   Minimum 1 year of relevant experience in contract administration, construction administration, or a similar role  Tertiary qualification in business, commerce, construction management, or a related discipline (or equivalent relevant experience)  Strong organisational and communication skills  Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook)  Ability to liaise effectively with contractors, project stakeholders, and senior management  Sound understanding of contract documentation and compliance requirements   About Company     SBDC Testing is a trusted provider of concrete testing services, established in 2014 and operating across Australia. With a strong focus on accuracy, reliability, and integrity, SBDC has built a reputation for delivering high-quality testing solutions that support the successful delivery of major infrastructure and construction projects.    Our team works closely with builders, concrete suppliers, and engineers to ensure every aspect of testing is carried out in strict accordance with Australian Standards, providing confidence that all materials meet required specifications.    At SBDC Testing, we pride ourselves on being responsive, professional, and solutions focused. Our commitment is simple: accurate, timely and dependable testing that helps clients minimise risk, maintain compliance, and deliver projects with confidence.
